comment: Which APK fits which head unit. Software update downloads this file from the release and checks the unit against it, top to bottom; the first unit with a matching entry wins. An entry matches when all of its conditions hold: package (installed app), service (system service name), prop (system property set; with equals / startsWith), file (exists), hardware / manufacturer / model (contains, any case). Unknown conditions never match. The launcher also carries a copy (used offline and when this file is older).
